facts.text: The user wants a course description for Public Policy Analysis converted into 4 course learning outcomes (CLOs).
The user wants the 4 CLOs written using a high level of Bloom's taxonomy.
The user wants all 4 CLOs to be relevant to a 15-week course outline.
The course description includes concepts of public policy, characteristics of public policy, and models of public policy.
The course description includes the process of public policy analysis, including problems of public policy, policy alternatives, policy enforcement, policy implementation, and policy assessment.
The course description includes analytical techniques with strengths and limitations of public policy.
The course description includes examples of public policy research in Thailand and abroad.

keyphrases: public policy research Thailand and abroad
